item.title: Shooting outside Chicago White Castle leaves 2 men dead, suspects on the run
item.description: Two men were killed and a third is hospitalized after a shooting outside a White Castle restaurant Tuesday afternoon on Chicago’s Near West Side, police said.The shooting occurred about 1:20 p.m. in the 2300 block of West Roosevelt Road, according to Chicago police.Authorities said three men were inside a vehicle when they were approached by three armed male suspects, who opened fire into the car. item.title: Woman visiting UI Health fatally shot in UIC parking garage
item.description: A woman visiting UI Health for an appointment was fatally shot Tuesday afternoon in a University of Illinois Chicago parking garage, prompting campus alerts.UIC sent out an alert around 2:30 p.m. reporting police activity at 1100 S. Wood St. and asked people to avoid the area.In a follow-up alert at 2:54 p.m., the university said police were on the third level of the Wood Street Parking Structure and that there was no threat to campus. item.title: Chicago SNAP curfew proposal revised again, allowing 30-minute police dispersal warning
item.description: Chicago leaders are once again revising a proposed "snap curfew" ordinance, with a new draft giving police more flexibility before issuing citations.Under the latest version, Chicago police would be allowed to issue a 30-minute warning to disperse, instead of the previously proposed 12-hour window.Alderman Brian Hopkins said Mayor Brandon Johnson is now collaborating on the updated draft. item.title: Chicago woman tells Congress about Border Patrol shooting her in Brighton Park
item.description: A Chicago woman told members of Congress on Tuesday that Border Patrol shot her after she warned neighbors about agents in her neighborhood.Members of Congress hosted a forum in Washington on Tuesday, hearing testimony from people who said their lives were changed by ICE and Border Patrol agents, in some cases tragically.One of the speakers was Marimar Martinez from Chicago. item.title: Giants are hiring former Bears head coach Matt Nagy as offensive coordinator
item.description: The New York Giants are hiring Matt Nagy to be their offensive coordinator, according to a person with knowledge of the decision.The person spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity Tuesday because the move had not been announced.Nagy spent the past three seasons in that role with Kansas City, including helping the Chiefs win the Super Bowl in the 2023 season and reach the title game in 2024. item.description: Some local democratic leaders are ramping up pressure on Cook County State's Attorney Eileen O'Neill Burke, calling on her to investigate and prosecute federal immigration agents.The lawmakers include members of Chicago's City Council, the Cook County Board of Commissioners and Illinois State Representatives. item.title: Chicago weather: Changes ahead! Warmer air is finally on the horizon for the Chicago area
item.description: Skies became mostly cloudy this afternoon as clouds moved in off of Lake Michigan. item.title: Boy, 12, hospitalized after West Side shooting, police say
item.description: A 12-year-old boy is hospitalized with a graze wound after a shooting Tuesday on Chicago’s West Side, police said.The shooting occurred about 6:50 p.m. in the 900 block of North Leamington Avenue. The boy was inside a vehicle when he was struck by a gunshot graze wound to the head, according to Chicago police.He was taken to Loyola University Medical Center, where he was listed in fair condition.Police said two people of interest were taken into custody.
